cohort: The study included national perinatal registry data for singleton term deliveries in the Netherlands from 2001-2015.
finding: The study found that the publication of EURO-PERISTAT reports was associated with short-term changes in obstetric management, including increases in assisted vaginal deliveries (2003 report) and planned caesarean sections (2013 report), and decreases in assisted vaginal deliveries (2008 and 2013 reports).
mod_finding: The 2003 EURO-PERISTAT report was associated with higher relative risks for assisted vaginal delivery, while the 2013 report was associated with higher risks for a planned caesarean section and lower risks for an assisted vaginal delivery.
